TOR_005.title: Caleb & Joshua at Kadesh-Barnea ? Faith Over Fear (Numbers 13?14)
TOR_005.context: Ten scouts report fortified cities and giants in Canaan, causing the assembly to panic and demand a return to Egypt.
TOR_005.prompt: How do you steady the twelve tribes when majority opinion is paralyzed by fear?

options.text: Stand with Caleb and Joshua: 'The Lord is with us; do not fear them, we are well able to overcome'

outcomes.text: Numbers 14:24 fulfilled: wholly following the Lord secures covenant inheritance (+45 Score).
Courageous faith silences panic across the camp (+30 Score).

options.text: Yield to the fearful majority and appoint a captain to return to Egypt

outcomes.text: Unbelief forfeits immediate entry into the Promised Land (-20 Score).

HIS_005.title: Nehemiah Rebuilding Jerusalem's Walls ? Sword & Trowel (Nehemiah 4 & 6)
HIS_005.context: Sanballat and Tobiah mock the builders and plot a surprise attack while Jerusalem's gates lie half-restored.
HIS_005.prompt: How do you defend the city while keeping every family on schedule?

options.text: Post prayerful watchmen day and night, arm every builder with sword and trowel, and refuse distraction

outcomes.text: Nehemiah 6:15: the wall is completed in 52 days, and surrounding nations recognize God's hand (+50 Score).
Vigilant defense and disciplined labor protect every gate (+35 Score).

options.text: Halt construction to negotiate on the plain of Ono

outcomes.text: Leaving the great work stalls momentum and invites ambush (-15 Score).

WIS_004.title: Solomon's Temple Dedication & Wise Governance (1 Kings 3 & 8 / Proverbs 4)
WIS_004.context: As steward over a vast kingdom, you must prioritize either personal wealth or a discerning heart to govern God's people.
WIS_004.prompt: What foundation do you establish for generational leadership?

options.text: Ask God for an understanding heart to discern good and evil, and build the House of the Lord first

outcomes.text: 1 Kings 3:12: wisdom, honor, and peace flourish across every border (+45 Score).
Proverbs 4:7: getting wisdom establishes enduring justice (+30 Score).

options.text: Prioritize personal luxury and heavy taxation over covenant justice

outcomes.text: Oppressive burdens fracture tribal unity (-15 Score).

PRO_004.title: Jeremiah & Ezekiel ? New Covenant Heart of Flesh (Jeremiah 31:31?34 / Ezekiel 36)
PRO_004.context: Exile threatens to extinguish national identity as temples fall and captives sit by the rivers of Babylon.
PRO_004.prompt: What prophetic hope anchors the remnant through seventy years of exile?

options.text: Proclaim God's New Covenant written on the heart, seek the welfare of the city, and prepare for restoration

outcomes.text: Jeremiah 31:33 & Ezekiel 36:26: God replaces hearts of stone with hearts of flesh (+50 Score).
Prophetic breath raises an exceeding great army from dry bones (+35 Score).

options.text: Listen to false prophets promising effortless escape without repentance

outcomes.text: Whitewashed walls collapse under prophetic scrutiny (-20 Score).

GOS_004.title: The Good Samaritan & Kingdom Mercy (Luke 10:25?37)
GOS_004.context: A wounded traveler lies stripped and half-dead along the steep road from Jerusalem to Jericho.
GOS_004.prompt: How do you demonstrate authentic covenant neighbor-love?

options.text: Show active compassion, bind his wounds, carry him to safety, and cover his full care

outcomes.text: Luke 10:37: 'Go and do likewise'?sacrificial mercy fulfills the royal law (+45 Score).
Practical generosity heals broken lives (+30 Score).

options.text: Pass by on the other side to avoid inconvenience

outcomes.text: Religious titles without mercy miss the heart of the Law (-15 Score).

EPI_004.title: The Great Cloud of Witnesses & Unshakable Kingdom (Hebrews 11?12)
EPI_004.context: Believers under heavy pressure are tempted to drift backward instead of pressing forward in faith.
EPI_004.prompt: How do you run the race set before the church?

options.text: Lay aside every weight, fix eyes on Jesus the Author and Finisher of faith, and receive an unshakable Kingdom

outcomes.text: Hebrews 12:2 & 12:28: enduring with gratitude and awe inherits the unshakable Kingdom (+55 Score).
Faithful endurance honors every patriarch and martyr (+40 Score).

options.text: Shrink back in fear and neglect gathering with the assembly

outcomes.text: Neglecting fellowship weakens spiritual resilience (-20 Score).

scripture_trials.prompt: Which two Torah commandments did Jesus identify as the foundation on which all the Law and Prophets depend?
options: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and might, and love your neighbor as yourself
Offer daily grain taxes and build stone towers in every valley
Restrict hospitality solely to royal officials
Memorize genealogy lists without practicing justice
scripture_trials.explanation: Deuteronomy 6:5 and Leviticus 19:18 summarize the entire covenant ethic of love toward God and neighbor.

scripture_trials.prompt: What declaration did Ezra and Nehemiah speak to strengthen the returned exiles as Scripture was read aloud?
options: Do not be grieved, for the joy of the Lord is your strength
Weep continuously because the walls are weak
Close the scroll until foreign kings grant permission
Strength comes only from fortified chariots
scripture_trials.explanation: Nehemiah 8:10 anchors covenant renewal in the sustaining joy of the Lord.

scripture_trials.prompt: According to Proverbs 3:5?6, what happens when we trust in the Lord with all our heart and acknowledge Him in all our ways?
options: He will make straight our paths
We never face any decisions
Human understanding replaces prayer
Wealth is guaranteed without diligence
scripture_trials.explanation: Proverbs 3:5?6 promises divine direction when we lean on God rather than our own limited insight.

scripture_trials.prompt: What three things does the Lord require of His people according to Micah 6:8?
options: To do justice, to love kindness (mercy), and to walk humbly with your God
To multiply burnt offerings, build palaces, and silence the poor
To isolate from every city and avoid public justice
To rely on ritual without integrity
scripture_trials.explanation: Micah 6:8 distills prophetic covenant ethics into justice, steadfast mercy, and humble walk with God.

scripture_trials.prompt: What power and geographic mission did Jesus promise His disciples before His ascension in Acts 1:8?
options: Power when the Holy Spirit comes upon them, to be His witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and to the end of the earth
Political office inside the Roman Senate
Immediate withdrawal from public witness
Authority limited strictly to Galilee
scripture_trials.explanation: Acts 1:8 outlines the Spirit-empowered global expansion of the Gospel.

scripture_trials.prompt: How does Romans 8 describe the believer's standing in Christ amid tribulation or distress?
options: God works all things together for good for those who love Him, and in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us
Trials prove God has abandoned His people
Victory belongs only to those without hardship
Condemnation remains over those in Christ Jesus
scripture_trials.explanation: Romans 8:28?39 guarantees unbreakable covenant love and victory in Christ.
